layout.source: New Makan visual reference; Light/Dark/Components are visual lineage, not backend requirements.
contracts: Search is one horizontal row with input inside wrapper
Composer and action footer are in layout, not fixed overlays over content
Install entry stays reachable without covering composer
Preserve drafts and list position on resize and theme switch
Do not change account inbox or independent class list when school context changes
layout.claims: These values specify the design. They do not certify app runtime, native keyboard or API implementation.
